-- A name is plain when it is a single path component: it is non-empty,
-- is not "." or "..", and contains no "/", "\" or NUL.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  ex is_plain_name("..") == False
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex is_plain_name("a/b") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == "\0"
      return False
  True

-- Reads notes/<name>. The function accepts any name, so there is no pre.
-- An unsafe, missing or unreadable name gives "". The body confines fs
-- to "notes" with `with fs = fs.sub("notes")`.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  ex read_note("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_note("missing-note.txt") == ""
  if not is_plain_name(name)
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text
